limitations: Synthetic, paid, DOM-free engine comparison. Not human win rates or tuning evidence.
One declared seed and normal AI only; mirrored sides are separate simulations, not assumed identical outcomes.
Paid scripted decisions are synthetic and faster/more consistent than human input. No native browser/UI evidence is provided by this study.
Open-ended games remaining alive at 600 seconds are ongoing. No forced endings or policy/reward tuning.

Bridge-dependent ledger action means current gold minus cumulative bridge receipts would not pay for the action with all other recorded transactions held fixed. Diverging kill/build histories prevent interpreting this as a full causal counterfactual.
The 90-second citadel leader can be tied; army count and payout leaders are separate descriptive values.
Zone occupancy is the engine fixed-step sample; crossing time is quantized to 0.05 seconds. Empty payout accounting counts only stable owners empty in the post-step sample.
